children.description: Sensor Hub provides links to sensor and algorithms in order to retrieve data from them.
children.name: Sensor Hub

data_rate.description: Defines the sensor's and algorithm's data rate in Hz. If accelerometer or gyroscope is selected as data rate source, the closest higher available output data rate (ODR) is selected.
data_rate.name: Data Rate

children.description: Retrieves the heading value reference to magnetic North. Sample rate for this algorithm is 100Hz, Data Rate of the Sensor Hub must be set equal or higher.
children.name: Heading 9X

children.description: Retrieves the magnetometer Hard-Iron calibration coefficients and quality of calibration index. Sample rate for this algorithm is 100Hz, Data Rate of the Sensor Hub must be set equal or higher.
children.name: Magnetometer Calibration Coefficients

outputs.description: Hard-Iron calibration coefficients in microtesla unit.
outputs.name: data
